name: deepseek-harness-desktop-workspace
description: A desktop host for DeepSeek Harness

scripts.bootstrap: pnpm harness:install && pnpm harness:build && pnpm build
scripts.build: pnpm --filter @openworkbuddy/dsh-client-ui-desktop-chrome run build && pnpm --filter @openworkbuddy/dsh-client-ui-home-hero run build && pnpm --filter @openworkbuddy/dsh-client-ui-agent-preset-sections run build && pnpm --filter @deepseek-harness/desktop run build
scripts.check: pnpm --filter @openworkbuddy/dsh-client-ui-desktop-chrome run check && pnpm --filter @openworkbuddy/dsh-client-ui-home-hero run check && pnpm --filter @openworkbuddy/dsh-client-ui-agent-preset-sections run check && pnpm --filter @deepseek-harness/desktop run check
